data.name: Actions.StartCountdown.Description
data.value: Start a countdown of the given length, replacing any running one. Zero starts nothing and fires the finished event at once.

data.name: Actions.StartCountdown.Hours.Description
data.value: Whole hours of the countdown, from 0 to 24.

data.name: Actions.StartCountdown.Minutes.Description
data.value: Minutes of the countdown, from 0 to 59.

data.name: Actions.StartCountdown.Seconds.Description
data.value: Seconds of the countdown, from 0 to 59.

data.name: Actions.StartCountdown.TimerLabel.Description
data.value: Optional name shown with the countdown and its finished event.

data.name: Actions.PauseCountdown.Description
data.value: Pause the running countdown, keeping the time left.

data.name: Actions.CancelCountdown.Description
data.value: Stop the countdown and clear it.

data.name: Actions.ToggleCountdown.Description
data.value: Pause a running countdown, or resume a paused one.

data.name: Actions.AdjustCountdown.Description
data.value: Add or remove time on the running or paused countdown. Adjusting past zero finishes it at once.

data.name: Actions.AdjustCountdown.Delta.Description
data.value: Seconds to add, negative to subtract.

data.name: Actions.StopStopwatch.Description
data.value: Pause the stopwatch, keeping the elapsed time.

data.name: Actions.ResetStopwatch.Description
data.value: Stop the stopwatch and clear it to zero.

data.name: Actions.ToggleStopwatch.Description
data.value: Start the stopwatch when stopped, stop it when running.

data.name: Actions.StartPomodoro.Description
data.value: Start a Pomodoro cycle of focus and breaks, replacing any running one.

data.name: Actions.StartPomodoro.WorkMinutes.Description
data.value: Length of one focus session, from 1 to 180.

data.name: Actions.StartPomodoro.ShortBreak.Description
data.value: Length of a short break, from 1 to 60.

data.name: Actions.StartPomodoro.LongBreak.Description
data.value: Length of the long break, from 1 to 90.

data.name: Actions.StartPomodoro.Rounds.Description
data.value: Focus sessions before the long break, from 1 to 12.

data.name: Actions.StartPomodoro.AutoAdvance.Description
data.value: Move to the next phase automatically when one finishes.

data.name: Actions.StopPomodoro.Description
data.value: Stop the Pomodoro cycle and go back to idle.

data.name: Actions.SkipPomodoroPhase.Description
data.value: Finish the current Pomodoro phase at once and move on.

data.name: Actions.TogglePomodoro.Description
data.value: Pause a running Pomodoro phase, or resume a paused one.

data.name: Events.PomodoroPhaseChanged.Description
data.value: Fires when the Pomodoro cycle moves to another phase.

data.name: Variables.PomodoroPhase.Description
data.value: Current Pomodoro phase: idle, focus, short-break or long-break.

data.name: Variables.PomodoroRemaining.Description
data.value: Seconds left in the current Pomodoro phase.

data.name: Variables.PomodoroPhaseText.Description
data.value: Time left in the current Pomodoro phase, formatted as minutes and seconds.

data.name: Variables.PomodoroLabel.Description
data.value: The label of the current Pomodoro phase, if any.

data.name: Variables.PomodoroRound.Description
data.value: The current focus round, starting at 1.

data.name: Variables.PomodoroRunning.Description
data.value: Whether a Pomodoro phase is currently running.

data.name: Variables.PomodoroProgress.Description
data.value: How much of the current Pomodoro phase has elapsed, from 0 to 100.

data.name: Widget.FocusTimer.Description
data.value: Countdown, stopwatch or Pomodoro with progress and controls.

data.name: Widget.Config.ModeDescription
data.value: What this widget runs and shows.

data.name: Widget.Config.CountdownMinutesDescription
data.value: Length started by the widget button in countdown mode.

data.name: Widget.Config.WorkMinutesDescription
data.value: Length of one focus session in Pomodoro mode.

data.name: Widget.Config.ShortBreakMinutesDescription
data.value: Length of a short break in Pomodoro mode.

data.name: Widget.Config.LongBreakMinutesDescription
data.value: Length of the long break in Pomodoro mode.

data.name: Widget.Config.RoundsDescription
data.value: Focus sessions before the long break.

data.name: Widget.Config.AutoAdvanceDescription
data.value: Move to the next phase automatically when one finishes.

data.name: Widget.Config.AccentColorDescription
data.value: Progress color as a hex value. Empty uses the deck default.

data.name: Events.CountdownFinished.Description
data.value: Fires when a countdown reaches zero.

data.name: Variables.CountdownText.Description
data.value: Countdown time left formatted as minutes and seconds.

data.name: Variables.CountdownRunning.Description
data.value: Whether a countdown is currently running.

data.name: Variables.CountdownLabel.Description
data.value: The label of the current countdown, if any.

data.name: Variables.CountdownProgress.Description
data.value: How much of the countdown has elapsed, from 0 to 100.

data.name: Variables.StopwatchText.Description
data.value: Stopwatch time formatted as minutes and seconds.

data.name: Variables.StopwatchRunning.Description
data.value: Whether the stopwatch is currently running.
